title: Principal created
description: A person's principal was created: at their first sign-in, or by SCIM provisioning (HUM-02, HUM-05, AUD-01). It names the person by the principal's pseudonymous ID only, never by name, email address or IdP subject (NFR-20).

actor.description: The person who signed in, the break-glass custodian, or SCIM's service account.

method.description: How the principal was created: a sign-in from a browser through the identity provider, the CLI's exchange of an ID token, the first use of break-glass, or SCIM provisioning.

idp_groups.description: The groups that the identity provider gave the principal, from which its roles come (HUM-02): sorted, each once.
